We're hiring: Operation Director for the new SCIENCE Makerspace (UCPH) , University of Copenhagen, Denmark

Do you thrive at the intersection of leadership, innovation, education, and community-building?

The Faculty of SCIENCE at the University of Copenhagen is establishing a 600 m² interdisciplinary Makerspace, backed by DKK 42 million from the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and we're looking for an Operation Director to help shape it from the ground up.

This is a unique opportunity to help build and lead one of the most ambitious educational initiatives at the University of Copenhagen, Denmark

In this role, you'll lead the Makerspace team, drive the establishment and daily operation of a world-class learning environment, and work with faculty leaders to transform teaching and learning across 12 science departments. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with experience in leadership and organizational development, and an interest in makerspaces and higher education.

We're particularly interested in reaching candidates who are passionate about inclusive learning environments, interdisciplinary collaboration, student engagement, and creating something entirely new.

📍 Copenhagen, Denmark 🏛 University of Copenhagen, Faculty of SCIENCE 🔗 Learn more: ucphmakerspace.dk /
